reason: The cited evidence (E1) only shows that an electrospark-deposited HfNbTaTiZr coating on stainless steel provides corrosion resistance in saline solution at ambient temperature. It does not address high-temperature oxidation, oxide scale formation, oxygen diffusion barrier properties, or the effect of the coating on the mechanical properties of a cast HfNbTaTiZr substrate. Therefore, none of the key premises specific to the high-temperature oxygen resistance and mechanical performance retention are supported.
premises: Electrospark deposition can apply a protective coating derived from HfNbTaTiZr HEA onto a substrate.
The coating will form a dense, adherent oxide scale that acts as an oxygen diffusion barrier at 1000 °C.
The coating will not degrade the base alloy's room-temperature ductility or high-temperature yield strength.
The coating will significantly reduce oxygen uptake and surface oxidation during 100-hour air exposure at 1000 °C.
